status-and-vertical-cut.text: One implementation task makes the generic conformance session execute CG21 and emit its complete receipt across all required layers.

surface-map.text: Lean is read-only. The owned layers are conformance execution, receipt evidence, inventory and CI, and the reader-facing copy.

owner-sequence.text: The owner commits RED, then fold, duplicate, keyed-mint sequence, workflow and copy checkpoints while the persistent auditor reviews decisions asynchronously.

gate-and-review.text: Two independent authors map the lines to existing CI commands. The ticket owner freezes their union, and push waits for all checkpoint approvals and one final gate run.

copies-and-release-boundary.text: Inventory, workflow, receipt schema and tests, consumer page and speech move together. Remote CI gates readiness and the epic owner merges.

budget-and-remainder.text: The owner has four hours and one final Gate S. Only a green coherent vertical can be pushed at the cap.
